Root cause: The search request did not include with_payload=true, so Qdrant correctly omitted payload fields from response by design. Independent verification via direct point lookup (POST /points with ids=[2,4] and with_payload=true) confirmed both returned points have payload.color='red' - no actual filter violation exists.
